# Gradle Wrapper JAR

The gradle-wrapper.jar file should be placed here.

## How to generate it:

If you have Gradle installed locally, run:

```bash
gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.4
```

Or download it directly from:
https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.4-bin.zip

Extract and copy gradle-wrapper.jar to this directory.

## Alternative

You can also initialize the project in Android Studio, which will automatically download and set up the Gradle wrapper.
